B includes a coherent collagen biosynthesis/basement membrane/fibril crosslinking theme and a PDGF-response stromal theme that capture what this collagen-production module actually does, which A lacks (A has only collagen degradation), although B is cluttered with many near-duplicate fibroblast/adhesion themes.

B covers the key facets (GPCR chemotaxis, degranulation, extravasation/diapedesis, chemokine induction, TLR/inflammatory signalling, respiratory burst) in 10 themes, while A repeats these across 22 near-duplicate themes and adds only peripheral granule-maturation and killing variants.

A gives a clean nested ladder from COX/prostaglandin synthesis through prostanoid receptors and fever regulation, the CYP450 and lipoxygenase/leukotriene eicosanoid branches, resolvins, up to platelet/coagulation, whereas B covers the same contexts with 19 heavily overlapping themes and adds only marginal purinergic and phospholipid-remodelling variants.
